_doc.doc: The opening drop's numbers (owner item 107, docs/decisions/0012). Ship to ground, untouched, is about 24 s (--drop-check's band); raise sky_y and the fall speeds together to keep that. float: no keys. dive: forward held. deploy_h / burst_h: m over the ground below where the glider opens / a comet bursts. camera: wide_zoom is the pull-out's distance over the match camera's (the whole island in view from the jump), pull_s how fast it gets there, ease_from / ease_to the height (share of sky_y) over which it comes back to near_zoom, near the play zoom, wide_chase the tilt (0 = the match angle, 1 = low behind), island_focus how far the wide view leans to the island's middle. look: cloud_y the cloud deck, puffs the clouds you fall past (scaled by the quality's fx), rush_float / rush_dive the speed lines at a float and a dive, trail_pts a diver's contrail, wind_build_s how long the wind takes to build.
